asset.name: Nebula Bounded Generation Projection Model
asset.description: Authoritative PostgreSQL control model and rebuildable Nebula identities for BUILDING, ACTIVE, and PREVIOUS exact-Scope projection generations.
relationships: One exact Scope has one mutable Projection Head.
One Projection Head references at most one BUILDING, one ACTIVE, and one PREVIOUS immutable Manifest.
One Manifest owns generation-qualified vertices, edges, partition checkpoints, and cleanup chunks.
Knowledge Assertions connect Design Assets to BIZ, SYS, or TECH Architecture Units within one Manifest.
constraints: PostgreSQL is authoritative for Manifests, head pointers, history, and source watermarks.
Every graph identity contains exact Scope and Manifest identity.
Cross-Scope and cross-Manifest edges are invalid.
Cleanup can never select the ACTIVE Manifest.
asset.lifecycle: A Manifest moves through BUILDING and VALIDATING before pointer-based activation; old ACTIVE becomes PREVIOUS, then RETIRED, PURGING, and PURGED or ARCHIVED.
asset.lineage: Authoritative PostgreSQL Design Assets, Knowledge Assertions, Evidence, Baselines, Profiles, Relationship Events, and transactional Outbox records.

en.decision: Introduce a durable hybrid assessment center with immutable evidence snapshots, deterministic coverage and hard constraints, heuristic planning ranges, explicit AI token budgets, independent review, and stale-assessment rejection.

zh.decision: 引入持久化混合评估中心：使用不可变证据快照、确定性的覆盖与硬约束检查、启发式规划区间、明确的 AI Token 预算、独立审核和失效评估拒绝。
alternatives: 纯规则评估：否决，因为它不能可靠拆解含糊的自然语言意图，也不能提供有价值的语义方案比较。
纯 AI 评估：否决，因为在证据缺失或矛盾时难以复现、审计、限定范围和失败关闭。
证据驱动的混合评估：采纳，确定性策略保护硬边界，AI 负责语义理解和方案生成。
consequences: 需求可行性变为有证据支持的判断，证据不足时可以明确返回 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE。
影响分析能够覆盖设计、代码、迁移、兼容、测试、发布、回滚、文档和治理工作。
通过 AI Work Units 以及有版本的模型/执行档案，AI 执行成本可以比较。
由于证据快照和水位不可变，历史报告可以审计和复现。
第一阶段可以评估架构与设计可行性，但不能声称代码级可行性或校准后的交付准确度。
后续仍需实现持久化、Worker、MCP、Web 和对账能力。
constraints: PostgreSQL 对编写的评估和证据快照保持权威。
快照只能包含精确 Scope 的事实和已授权关系。
第一阶段不声明校准后的 P50/P90 预测或外部连接器交付。
